sourceName: Government of Viet Nam online newspaper (baochinhphu.vn) — Resolution No. 229/NQ-CP: visa exemption for citizens of 12 countries under the Tourism Stimulus Program
notes: Viet Nam's government resolution exempts citizens of Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia and Switzerland from a visa for a stay of 45 days from the date of entry for tourism, regardless of passport type, provided they meet the entry conditions under Vietnamese law. The exemption applies from 15 August 2025 to 14 August 2028 under the tourism stimulus programme.
